tldr: Lilith in Scorpio: Lilith in her most natural state; buried extremes and an instinct for danger.
body: With Lilith in Scorpio, the point operates at full strength. Emotions stay hidden until they erupt, vulnerability reads as danger, and an intuitive radar for threat runs constantly under the surface, honed by whatever shame or harm came before.
gift: Intensity, penetrating intuition, and survival power that can transform anything it finally faces.
challenge: Volatility when exposed, secrecy as armor, lashing out at whoever gets close to the wound.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
